snippet.title: Idle Bookstore // Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/4270230/Idle_Bookstore

Turn your daily typing into books. Every keystroke and click helps your desktop companion write books while you work or study. Publish their books, earn money, and grow your bookstore.

👥 Players: Single-player, Online Co-op
🛠️ Developer: Purpledoor Studios
📚 Publisher: Purpledoor Studios
📅 Release Date: Sep 15, 2026
🎯 Genre: Casual, Indie, Simulation, Strategy
